name: Hide
email_note: Hide does not publish an email address. Its site uses a contact form. Call 020 3146 8666 for the events team's email, or use the form at hide.co.uk/private-dining-mayfair/.
chef: Josh Angus (Chef Director); opened by Ollie Dabbous, who left in 2025
speciality: Three floors joined by an oak spiral staircase, with views over Green Park. Ground is an all-day restaurant and Above serves the tasting menu. The wine list comes from Hedonism Wines, with over 6,500 bins.
signature_dishes: Seasonal and vegetable-led menus that change often
menu_summary: Breakfast, à la carte, vegetarian à la carte, set lunch, tasting menu and vegetarian tasting menu. Private dining packages cost £90 to £150 per head in the Hide & Seek Rooms.
private_dining: Hide & Seek Rooms (12 each, 24 combined); The Piccadilly View (up to 40); Broken, Shadow and Reading Rooms in the vaults (2–8); mezzanine for semi-exclusive hire

name: Restaurant Story
speciality: Tom Sellers opened his flagship in 2013. Each course of the tasting menu tells a story from his life and career, using British seasonal produce.
signature_dishes: Bread & Dripping (a beef dripping candle that melts beside warm sourdough); Storeos; half-time oranges
menu_summary: 7-course tasting menu £275 pp at lunch or dinner. 5-course lunch menu £175 pp. Drinks flight or wine list.
private_dining: First-floor private dining room: one wooden table over the open kitchen, a balcony with Shard views and a lounge. Exclusive hire up to 32. Tue–Sat, bespoke menus.
fit_15_20: Up to 16 in the private room; 17–20 needs exclusive hire

name: The Clove Club
email_note: The FAQ asks for private events and large-group requests at reservations@.
address: Shoreditch Town Hall, 380 Old Street, London EC1V 9LT
speciality: Relaxed fine dining inside the Grade II listed Shoreditch Town Hall. The tasting menu features British seafood, wild game, dairy and organic vegetables, shaped by McHale's memories and travels.
signature_dishes: Buttermilk fried chicken with pine salt; seasonal British seafood courses
menu_summary: Tasting dinner menu £285 pp (Mon, Thu–Sat). A lower Tue/Wed price was offered in 2026. Online booking takes up to 6; larger groups book by email.
private_dining: Private event and party packages, including patio hire. Ask for room options for 15–20.
notes: Open Mon dinner and Tue–Sat lunch and dinner; closed Sunday.

name: Da Terra
email_note: The private dining page asks for buyout and Na Mesa enquiries at booking@.
address: Town Hall Hotel, 8 Patriot Square, London E2 9NF
speciality: Rafael Cagali cooks a surprise tasting menu drawn from his Brazilian and Italian roots. The 28-seat room has an open kitchen that every table can see, inside the Grade II listed Town Hall Hotel.
signature_dishes: Reinvented Brazilian moqueca; The Humble Chicken
menu_summary: Surprise tasting menu of about 9 courses, around £260 pp. Shorter menu about £185 pp.
private_dining: Na Mesa private room (up to 10); full restaurant buyout (about 28)
room: the restaurant on an exclusive buyout basis

name: Frog by Adam Handling
email_note: The site gives only info@ for events.
speciality: The flagship of the Adam Handling group, opened in 2017. It serves technical, seasonal cooking with bold pairings and has a zero-waste approach. Eve Bar is downstairs.
signature_dishes: Cheese doughnuts; seasonal tasting menu courses
menu_summary: 13-course tasting menu £199 pp with optional supplements. Shorter lunch menu £100 pp.
private_dining: The Library private room downstairs (up to 12) with its own team; exclusive hire and events
room: The Library, or the restaurant on an exclusive basis

name: Aulis London
address: 16 St Anne's Court, Soho, London W1F 0BF
cuisine: Modern British chef's table, farm to table
chef: Simon Rogan; Head Chef Mark Catchpole
speciality: A 12-seat interactive chef's table. Chefs cook and explain each course in front of guests, using produce from Simon Rogan's Our Farm in Cartmel.
signature_dishes: Crispy chicken skin with Cornish crab and yuzu; roasted miso maitake with fermented cep; caramelised Pink Lady apple with meadowsweet
menu_summary: One multi-course tasting menu at £195 pp, paid in advance. Wine and drinks pairings are paid on the night.
private_dining: Exclusive hire of the whole chef's table for up to 12. No hire fee; minimum spend applies.
room: the chef's table on an exclusive basis
notes: Too small for 15–20. Consider it for a smaller leadership dinner.

name: Benares
email_note: Emails use the .co.uk domain although the website is .com.
address: 12a Berkeley Square House, Berkeley Square, London W1J 6BS
speciality: Modern Indian fine dining with bold flavours, contrasting textures and precise, playful plating. It has four private rooms and a large lounge bar, and is a Mayfair favourite for business dinners.
signature_dishes: Samosa Ragda Tartlet; Scallop Malabar; Hiran Boti Tikka; Lamb Chop Pulao; Benares Black Lentils
menu_summary: À la carte and tasting menu (£135 pp, paired wines £129). Set lunch from £43. Group menus include Bayleaf (£78) and Tasting (£129).
private_dining: Chef's Table (8), Sommelier's Table (10), Berkeley Room (16), Dover Room (36)
room: the Dover Room or the Berkeley Room
fit_15_20: Yes: Dover Room, or Berkeley Room for 16

name: Muse by Tom Aikens
email_note: Sebastian, the General Manager, handles events.
speciality: A 23-cover mews house on two floors, each with an open kitchen. Each course of the tasting menu is named after a memory from Tom Aikens' life.
signature_dishes: Just down the road (beetroot, ricotta, bergamot); bread course with chicken and cep butter; Forever picking
menu_summary: Seasonal tasting menu around £220 pp, wine pairing around £130. Groups larger than 6 get a set seasonal 3-course menu.
private_dining: Upstairs private room (16, plus 6 at the chef's counter); ground floor semi-private; exclusive hire of the townhouse (groups up to 25)
room: your upstairs private dining room and chef's counter
fit_15_20: Yes: upstairs room plus counter, or exclusive hire
notes: Sources disagree on course count and price. Ask for a group quote.

name: Alain Ducasse at The Dorchester
email_note: The private dining contact is a named person (Luize Mikelsone, +44 20 7319 7384), so the RFP also goes to reservations.
address: The Dorchester, 53 Park Lane, London W1K 1QA
chef: Alain Ducasse; Executive Chef Jean-Philippe Blondet
speciality: Contemporary French haute cuisine made with the best seasonal British and French produce. The dining room was redesigned in 2020. Table Lumière sits under a curtain of 4,500 fibre optics.
signature_dishes: Baba like in Monte-Carlo (rum baba); seasonal tasting menu
menu_summary: Lunch menu, à la carte and tasting menu. The 2026 tasting price is not published online; recent figures run about £285 pp, with collaboration menus from £300.
private_dining: Table Lumière (semi-private), Salon Privé (up to 12), Salon Park Lane (14 to 30, sources disagree). Menus are tailored.
capacity_seated: Up to 30 across the private spaces

name: Hélène Darroze at The Connaught
email_note: The official page lists this address for private dining and bespoke requests.
address: The Connaught, Carlos Place, London W1K 2AL
chef: Hélène Darroze; Executive Chef Marco Zampese
speciality: Seasonal French cooking led by produce and shaped by Darroze's South-West French roots and her travels. The Chef's Table is a pink marble table on a terrazzo dais inside the kitchen.
signature_dishes: Isle of Mull lobster with tandoori spices; Baba with a choice of Marc Darroze Armagnacs
menu_summary: Seasonal Taste of tasting menu (about 7 courses) at lunch and dinner, with wine or alcohol-free pairings. À la carte lunch from spring 2026.
private_dining: Chef's Table in the kitchen; private dining for larger parties (capacities not published). The Connaught's events team may also help.
notes: Ask whether the hotel's events team should handle a group of 15–20.

name: Galvin La Chapelle
chef: Chris & Jeff Galvin; Chef Director Arturo Granato
speciality: Refined French-Mediterranean cooking in a Grade II listed Victorian school chapel in Spitalfields. A mezzanine gallery looks over the main hall.
signature_dishes: Lasagne of Dorset crab; Dorset crab raviolo with fennel and beurre blanc
menu_summary: 8-course tasting menu £155 pp; pairings £80 (Classic) or £130 (Sommelier). À la carte, seasonal menus and £49 Toast & Taste. No à la carte in private rooms.
private_dining: The Gallery (mezzanine, 16 seated), The Arch (up to 27), exclusive hire (110 seated, 150 standing)
